description: Get one span in a Sentry trace by trace ID and span ID: its attributes, timing, errors, and child spans. For a whole-trace overview, use get_trace_details.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

spanId.description: A span ID in the trace.

name: get_span_details
title: Get Span Details
